note: The 98th percentile is a different order statistic at different record lengths. Under linear interpolation the index is (n-1)*0.98, so a short record reads its p98 from near the maximum and a long record reads it from further inside the upper tail. bracket_gap is the distance between the two daily values the statistic is interpolated between; where that gap is wide, a small difference in n or in quantile convention moves the statistic a long way without any change in the underlying measurements.
